elaine_sales: Hey team — need quick approval path. NovaMaps (seed, US) wants a 90-day POC that needs Hosted API + a small Dedicated pool for peak routing. They're in the startup program but already used the standard $5k credit. Can we top them up with a promo/exception?

mike_se: Quick Q: what's the expected qps and token volume? also will they use streaming and embeddings in the POC?

elaine_sales: Estimated 200k tokens/day peak, streaming for live geocoding responses, embedding vectors for search (50k vectors). They asked for $15k credit to cover 90 days + reduced rate on Dedicated burst.

amanda_revops: FYI startup program limits are $5k in credits + 30 days. For exceptions we need a deal desk ticket + justification (growth signal). Please include ARR or runway and product plan.

elaine_sales: Adding context: founder is ex-google maps, Y Combinator S23, currently raised $2.5M and wants to move from toy to pilot with three enterprise prospects. POC timeline: Apr 1 - Jun 30.

julian_dealdesk: @elaine_sales thanks. For a credit top-up to $15k we need: 1) expected monthly spend post-trial, 2) whether they'll sign a paid contract within 90 days, 3) any required legal terms (e.g., limited indemnity). Also need an internal approver (AM/AE) and revenue motion (self-serve>enterprise).

elaine_sales: Expected post-trial committed spend: $3k/mo on hosted + $1k/mo for Dedicated (small pool). They committed to an evaluation report and a commercial pilot agreement if the POC meets latency targets. AE on the deal is me.

nina_security: Heads up — they asked for SAML SSO and audit logs for the trial. Private deployment is not in scope, but we need to confirm we can provide tenant-level audit logs on Hosted and confirm cookie/data residency. Also ask for their SOC2 questionnaire?

mike_se: On infra: Dedicated burst for short windows is fine. ops_oncall — do we have capacity in us-west for a small Dedicated pool Apr-June?

ops_oncall: We have headroom but need early notice for provisioning. Please submit capacity request by 3/25. For Dedicated pricing we can offer a short-term burst discount of 15% if they sign a 6mo commit after POC.

amanda_revops: If Deal Desk approves, I can issue a one-time promo code for $10k credit and a separate negotiated commitment discount for Dedicated. For the extra $5k ask we'd need a signed LOI or recorded commitment to sign pilot with terms.

julian_dealdesk: Action items for approval: elaine -> upload one-pager (use case + contract cadence) + runbook; mike -> latency SLO targets and capacity plan; nina -> confirm any special security controls required; amanda -> draft promo terms. I'll need those in the ticket before sign-off.

elaine_sales: Working on the one-pager now. Attaching short sketch in thread: ```POC scope: Hosted API (gen/chat/embeddings), Dedicated pool reserved for peak routing (max 2 gpus), Targets: p99 <250ms gen, embeddings <120ms, volume: est 200k tokens/day. Deliverable: pilot LOI by 6/30.```

se_bot: [automated] Created deal-desk ticket DD-2026-1745 and added participants: elaine_sales, julian_dealdesk, amanda_revops. Please add attachments within 48h. :white_check_mark:

elaine_sales: Great — will attach docs today. One more: can we include a clause that unused promo credit can convert to a 60-day extension if they ask? that helps their runway pitch.

julian_dealdesk: Prefer not to automatically extend credits, but we can add a one-time extension option conditional on submission of pilot results and a min spend threshold. I'll draft wording once we have the one-pager.

amanda_revops: OK, will prepare two promo templates: (A) $10k one-time credit now + 15% Dedicated discount on 6mo commit; (B) $15k credit contingent on LOI + 6mo commit. We'll submit both for DD review.

elaine_sales: Thanks all — tagging @nina_security for the SOC2 ask. I'll ping again once docs uploaded. :pray:

nina_security: Please ask them to send completed SOC2 + contact for infosec. We'll triage quickly for a POC scope.

julian_dealdesk: Marking this as awaiting attachments in DD-2026-1745. Will review once items are in.

mike_se: Happy to help with runbook and perf test plan. Ping when you want a call with infra.

elaine_sales: Will do — thanks everyone :rocket:
